cap_confirmation: Resolved levels: Crobat/Slaking/Lapras/Arcanine/Venusaur (all +1) L53, Mawile (+2) L54 = cap 54 + offset - 2 on Medium.

attempts.why: Won with two Pokemon left. Knock Off did most of the work: it stripped Venusaur's Black Sludge for 115, took the Choice Scarf off Slaking, and removed Arcanine's Sitrus and Lapras's Leftovers. Spore shut down Mega Mawile on the last turn so a 75 HP Mamoswine could finish it with 2x High Horsepower.

strategy_checks.check: Crobat sets Tailwind, or uses Taunt / Haze, behind Safety Goggles
strategy_checks.evidence: Crobat chose Brave Bird on turn 1 and was KOed by a 2x Icicle Crash the same turn. None of Tailwind, Taunt or Haze was ever selected, and the Safety Goggles never mattered because Amoonguss was held in reserve. A TAILWIND-flagged team never set Tailwind.

strategy_checks.check: Slaking's Choice Scarf covers its Truant downtime
strategy_checks.evidence: Loafed on turn 2 exactly as Truant requires, and its Double-Edge contributed to KOing Zapdos on turn 3. Knock Off removing the Scarf on turn 3 was the turn that defanged it, which is the correct authored counterplay.

strategy_checks.check: Lapras uses Freeze-Dry / Icy Wind and Water Absorb
strategy_checks.evidence: Only Hydro Pump and Protect were chosen. Freeze-Dry and Icy Wind were never used and Water Absorb was never tested. Lapras played as a generic Water attacker rather than the speed-control and Freeze-Dry answer the set implies.

strategy_checks.check: Arcanine Intimidate plus Extreme Speed priority
strategy_checks.evidence: Intimidate on entry; Extreme Speed removed a 12 HP Mega Gardevoir on turn 6 before it could fire a spread move. Correct priority usage.

strategy_checks.check: Venusaur's Thick Fat blunts Fire and Ice
strategy_checks.evidence: Flare Blitz and Icicle Crash were both halved all fight; it survived far longer than its HP suggests and its Sludge Bomb helped KO Zapdos.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Mawile converts Huge Power into knockouts
strategy_checks.evidence: Mega Evolved on entry turn 9 and Play Rough (2x on Dark) immediately KOed Incineroar. It is the correct closer for the team.

protect_ledger.payoff: at 49/164 it blocked both a Flare Blitz and a Hyper Voice, either of which was lethal
blocked a 2x Transistor Thunderbolt that would have KOed it from 135

protect_summary: 2 opponent Protects, both with clear payoff, 0 empty, no consecutive guarding. Given five of the six carry Protect, the team guards conservatively and well.
ai_notes: No illegal or nonsensical choice. The Crobat FAIL above is the third team in this block whose authored Tailwind never landed (see E0267 Swanna, E0268 Braviary), which reads as a systematic pattern rather than one bad team: fast frail setters keep choosing an attack on turn 1 and then die. Reported for the main agent as a cross-team observation, not scored as a per-battle defect.
level_change_rationale: Keep. Four player faints, won with two Pokemon left, and the closing Mega Mawile forced a Spore to answer. That is the right weight for a Battle Frontier brain placed just before the Gym.
cooler: Keep. Choice Scarf Truant Slaking is a real idea, Thick Fat Venusaur and Water Absorb Lapras are honest defensive glue, and Mega Mawile as the closer behind two Intimidates is a coherent Palace Maven identity. One concrete improvement: Crobat is carrying Haze, Taunt and Tailwind - three support moves and one attack - on the fastest and frailest body on the team, and it used the attack and died. Give the support role to Lapras or Mandibuzz-style bulk, or give Crobat a Focus Sash instead of the Safety Goggles it never needed, so the disruption package actually reaches the field.
legality_notes: No legality problem in the authored set.
verification_limit: No level change was made for this battle.
